description: This file defines an interface class IOmiProxy for interacting with an omi_dbus_api, providing methods to mount/unmount crypted bundles, and register/unregister error listeners. It declares the class, enums, and typedefs relevant to proxy operations.

classes.name: omi::IOmiProxy
classes.description: Interface class providing methods for managing crypted bundles and error listeners in the omi framework.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given container ID, file paths, and outputs the bundle path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle for the specified container ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener by ID.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
